gloss: road width; width of a road

definitions.gloss: road width; width of a road or path
definitions.explanation: The horizontal distance from one side of a road or path to the other.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{道幅|みちはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧。
{道幅|みちはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}く→広い：00704_hiroi⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧しやすく⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The road got wider and became easier to drive on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{道幅|みちはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{片側|かたがわ}→片側：20150_katagawa⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Due to construction, the road width has been restricted to one side only.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (road, path) and ⟦{幅|はば}→幅：03565_haba⟧ (width). A straightforward and commonly used word in everyday Japanese.

USAGE:
Often appears in driving contexts, traffic reports, and descriptions of streets. Many Japanese residential streets are very narrow, so {道幅|みちはば} is a practical concern for drivers. Also used in urban planning and real estate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道幅|みちはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{狭|せま}い→狭い：00750_semai⟧ — the road is narrow
- {道幅|みちはば}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ — the road is wide
- {道幅|みちはば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧ — to widen the road
- {道幅|みちはば}⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧ — road width restriction
